prompt: What is the name of the in-place, stable comparison sorting algorithm with a worst-case time complexity of O(n log n) and a best-case time complexity of O(n)?
answer:
**Block sort** (also called **block merge sort**) fits those requirements:

- **Stable:** Yes  
- **In-place:** Yes, using constant auxiliary space  
- **Best case:** \(O(n)\)  
- **Worst case:** \(O(n\log n)\)  
- **Comparison-based:** Yes  

It combines block-based in-place stable merging with bottom-up merge sort.
